stories.title: Nine Flintshire postcodes hit by Thursday night power cut
stories.summary: Part of Gwespyr is without power this evening after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 11.20pm.

stories.title: NHS trust says it did not know Betsi review findings when it appointed Carol Shillabeer
stories.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr chief executive Carol Shillabeer has withdrawn from a new job running an NHS trust in England, days after a review found serious failings in the health board’s leadership. stories.title: Woman who hid cocaine and MDMA in moisturiser tub at Creamfields sentenced
stories.summary: A 22-year-old woman from Bangor who hid cocaine and MDMA in a tub of moisturiser to get them into Creamfields has been given a suspended prison sentence. stories.title: Barrister’s advice sends Flintshire’s limits on challenging cabinet decisions back to full council
stories.summary: Flintshire councillors will vote next week on whether to keep new limits on their power to challenge cabinet decisions, after a barrister said the safest course was to look at them again.
